limitations: The tmpfs directory is a REFERENCE ONLY. It has no durability and no FUSE layer, so it is explicitly non-equivalent to WeftFS. No superiority claim follows from it.
No ext4/XFS/Btrfs/ZFS baseline is run in this pass; those filesystems are not available on the court's bind mount.
fio runs buffered (direct=0). Direct I/O is not benchmarked because same-inode concurrent direct I/O on kernel 7.3 can return EIO with this fuser version (see docs/fuse-status.md).
`fsync` through FUSE exercises the daemon's fsync path, not physical media power-loss durability.
Every run is in one OOM-limited container (memory==swap, pids, cpus). Throughput and latency are single-host observations, not hardware-independent claims.
The receipt embeds raw fio JSON but computes only medians of three repetitions; no confidence interval is claimed.

mountpoint=/mnt/weft-fuse/go

1020 1081 0:104 / /mnt/weft-fuse/go rw,nosuid,nodev,relatime - fuse.weftfs weftfs rw,user_id=0,group_id=0,default_permissions,max_read=131072
mounts.rust:
target=rust
store=/work/.docker-cache/fsbench/rust-store
mountpoint=/mnt/weft-fuse/rust
/mnt/weft-fuse/rust weftfs fuse   rw,nosuid,nodev,relatime,user_id=0,group_id=0,default_permissions,allow_other
1019 1081 0:103 / /mnt/weft-fuse/rust rw,nosuid,nodev,relatime - fuse weftfs rw,user_id=0,group_id=0,default_permissions,allow_other

notes: Both WeftFS mounts and the tmpfs directory are in the same container and run identical fio arguments.
The Go mount is recorded as `go_status=blocked` with the exact error when it cannot be built or mounted.
No `winner` field is emitted. See bench/RESULTS-v1.md for scoped analysis and losses.

workloads.fsync-write-4k: sequential write, 4 KiB blocks, 1 MiB, fsync after every write
workloads.rand-read-4k: random read, 4 KiB blocks, 8 MiB file, psync
workloads.rand-write-4k: random write, 4 KiB blocks, 8 MiB, psync
workloads.seq-read-1m: sequential read of the pre-created 8 MiB file, 1 MiB blocks
workloads.seq-write-1m: sequential write, 1 MiB blocks, 8 MiB, psync, buffered (direct=0)
